block, \"elapsed_s\": round(self.elapsed(), 1)})\n            logger.warning(f\"{self.repo}: soft cap reached, skipping block {block}\")\n            return False\n        return True\n\n    def tic(self) -> float:\n        if DEVICE.type == \"cuda\":\n            torch.cuda.synchronize()\n        return time.perf_counter()\n\n    def toc(self, key: str, t: float, cand_keys: tuple[str, ...] = ()) -> float:\n        if DEVICE.type == \"cuda\":\n            torch.cuda.synchronize()\n        dt = time.perf_counter() - t\n        logger.info(f\"  {self.repo.split('/')[-1][:28]} block {key}: {dt:.1f}s (elapsed {self.elapsed():.0f}s)\")\n        self.timing[key] = self.timing.get(key, 0.0) + dt\n        for c in cand_keys:\n            self.cand_seconds[c] = self.cand_seconds.get(c, 0.0) + dt / max(len(cand_keys), 1)\n        return dt\n\n    # -- model\n    def load(self) -> None:\n        t = time.time()\n        if DEVICE.type == \"cuda\":\n            torch.cuda.reset_peak_memory_stats()\n        self.model, self.tok, self.local = load_model(self.repo, torch.bfloat16)\n        if getattr(self.tok, \"_aii_tokenizer_source\", None):\n            self.flags.append(dict(self.tok._aii_tokenizer_source))\n        if DEVICE.type == \"cuda\" and VRAM_CAP_GB != VRAM_CAP_PLAN_GB:\n            self.flags.append({\"code\": \"VRAM_CAP_RAISED\", \"cap_gb\": VRAM_CAP_GB, \"plan_cap_gb\": VRAM_CAP_PLAN_GB})\n        self.layers = get_layers(self.model)\n        self.L = len(self.layers)\n        self.d = int(self.model.config.hidden_size)\n        L = self.L\n        self.L_h = min(int(round(0.5 * L)), L - 2)\n        self.B_mid = [self.L_h - 1, self.L_h, self.L_h + 1]\n        self.B_offset_mid = self.B_mid[0] - 1\n        self.B_late = [l for l in range(L) if 0.75 <= l / L <= 0.90 and l < L - 1]\n        if not self.B_late:\n            self.B_late = [int(0.8 * L)]\n        self.ref, self.com = onset_ids(self.tok)\n        W = self.model.get_output_embeddings().weight\n        self.W_rc = W[self.ref + self.com].detach().float().clone()\n        self.n_ref = len(self.ref)\n        self.u_vec = (self.W_rc[:self.n_ref].mean(0) - self.W_rc[self.n_ref:].mean(0)).detach().cpu().numpy().astype(np.float64)\n        self.norm_module = self.model.model.norm\n        self.norm_w = self.norm_module.weight.detach().float().cpu().numpy().astype(np.float64)\n        self.norm_eps = _norm_eps(self.norm_module)\n        eos = set()\n        for e in (self.tok.eos_token_id, getattr(self.model.generation_config, \"eos_token_id\", None)):\n            if isinstance(e, int):\n                eos.add(e)\n            elif isinstance(e, (list, tuple)):\n                eos.update(int(x) for x in e)\n        self.eos_ids = torch.tensor(sorted(eos) if eos else [-1])\n        self._normed = None\n\n        def norm_hook(mod, inp, out):\n            self._normed = out[:, -1, :]\n        self.norm_handle = self.model.model.norm.register_forward_hook(norm_hook)\n        probe = {}\n        h = self.layers[0].register_forward_hook(lambda m, i, o: probe.__setitem__(\"t\", isinstance(o, tuple)))\n        with torch.no_grad():\n            self.model(input_ids=torch.tensor([[self.tok.eos_token_id or 0]], device=DEVICE), use_cache=False,\n                       logits_to_keep=1)\n        h.remove()\n        self.out_is_tuple = bool(probe.get(\"t\", False))\n        self.timing[\"load_s\"] = time.time() - t\n        self.t_load_end = time.time()\n        logger.info(f\"{self.repo}: loaded in {self.timing['load_s']:.0f}s L={L} d={self.d} L_h={self.L_h} \"\n                    f\"B_mid={self.B_mid} B_late={self.B_late} |R|={len(self.ref)} |C|={len(self.com)} \"\n                    f\"tuple_out={self.out_is_tuple}\")\n\n    def unload(self) -> None:\n        try:\n            self.norm_handle.remove()\n        except AttributeError:\n            pass\n        for k in (\"model\", \"tok\", \"W_rc\", \"layers\"):\n            if hasattr(self, k):\n                delattr(self, k)\n        import gc\n        gc.collect()\n        if DEVICE.type == \"cuda\":\n            torch.cuda.empty_cache()\n\n    # -- readout\n    def margin_now(self) -> torch.Tensor:\n        z = self._normed.float() @ self.W_rc.T\n        return torch.logsumexp(z[:, : self.n_ref], -1) - torch.logsumexp(z[:, self.n_ref:], -1)\n\n    def batch(self, cond: str, prompts: list[str] | None = None, allowed: frozenset | None = None) -> Batch:\n        system = None if cond == \"plain\" else POLES[\"always_refuse\" if cond == \"pole_refuse\" else \"never_refuse\"]\n        prompts = prompts if prompts is not None else PROMPTS\n        allowed = allowed if allowed is not None else ALLOWED_PROMPTS\n        for p in prompts:\n            assert p in allowed\n        return build_batch(self.tok, self.repo, prompts, system, self.meta[\"template_mode_panel\"])\n\n    def wrap_batch(self, cond: str) -> Batch:\n        return self.batch(cond, WRAPPED_PROMPTS, ALLOWED_WRAPPED_PROMPTS)\n\n    # -- passes\n    def _cap(self, store: dict, l: int, full: bool = False):\n        def f(h: torch.Tensor):\n            store[l] = h.detach().clone() if full else h[:, -1, :].detach().float()\n            return None\n        return f\n\n    @torch.no_grad()\n    def _base_pass_once(self, b: Batch, full_layers: list[int], extra_fns: list | None = None) -> dict:\n        last: dict[int, torch.Tensor] = {}\n        full: dict[int, list[torch.Tensor]] = {l: [] for l in full_layers}\n        r0_store: dict[str, torch.Tensor] = {}\n\n        def mk(l: int):\n            def f(h: torch.Tensor):\n                last[l] = h[:, -1, :].detach().float()\n                if l in full:\n                    full[l].append(h.detach().clone())\n                return None\n            return f\n\n        def pre0(mod, args, kwargs=None):\n            h_in = args[0] if args else (kwargs or {}).get(\"hidden_states\")\n            r0_store[\"h\"] = h_in[:, -1, :].detach().float()\n        h0_handle = self.layers[0].register_forward_pre_hook(pre0, with_kwargs=True)\n        fns = list(extra_fns or []) + [(l, mk(l)) for l in range(self.L)]\n        try:\n            with hooks(self.layers, fns):\n                o1 = self.model(input_ids=b.ids[:, :-1], attention_mask=b.mask[:, :-1], position_ids=b.pos[:, :-1],\n                                use_cache=True, logits_to_keep=1)\n                cache = o1.past_key_values\n                o2 = self.model(input_ids=b.ids[:, -1:], attention_mask=b.mask, position_ids=b.pos[:, -1:],\n                                past_key_values=cache, use_cache=True, logits_to_keep=1)\n        finally:\n            h0_handle.remove()\n        m = self.margin_now().detach().cpu().numpy().astype(np.float64)\n        logits = o2.logits[:, -1, :].float()\n        lg_ref = torch.logsumexp(logits[:, self.ref], -1)\n        lg_com = torch.logsumexp(logits[:, self.com], -1)\n        m_logits = (lg_ref - lg_com).detach().cpu().numpy().astype(np.float64)\n        m_mean_logit = (logits[:, self.ref].mean(-1) - logits[:, self.com].mean(-1)).detach().cpu().numpy().astype(np.float64)\n        mass = torch.exp(lg_ref - torch.logsumexp(logits, -1)).detach().cpu().numpy().astype(np.float64)\n        R = torch.stack([last[l] for l in range(self.L)], 1).detach().cpu().numpy()\n        R0 = r0_store[\"h\"].detach().cpu().numpy().astype(np.float64)\n        normed_actual = self._normed.float().detach().cpu().numpy().astype(np.float64)\n        out = {\"m\": m, \"m_logits\": m_logits, \"m_mean_logit\": m_mean_logit, \"mass\": mass, \"R\": R, \"R0\": R0,\n              \"normed_actual\": normed_actual, \"cache\": cache, \"first_tok\": logits.argmax(-1),\n              \"full\": {l: torch.cat(v, 1) for l, v in full.items()}}\n        del o1, o2, logits\n        return out\n\n    def base_pass(self, b: Batch, full_layers: list[int], extra_fns: list | None = None) -> dict:\n        \"\"\"OOM_AT_10GB: on a CUDA OOM at the batch call, retry item-by-item (base_pass builds its own\n        KV cache from scratch, so a per-item retry is exact) and concatenate.\"\"\"\n        try:\n            return self._base_pass_once(b, full_layers, extra_fns)\n        except torch.cuda.OutOfMemoryError:\n            logger.warning(f\"{self.repo}: OOM in base_pass, retrying per item at the {VRAM_CAP_GB} GB cap\")\n            torch.cuda.empty_cache()\n            self.flags.append({\"code\": \"OOM_AT_10GB\", \"detail\": \"base_pass retried per-item\"})\n            parts = [self._base_pass_once(b.rows([i]), full_layers, extra_fns) for i in range(b.ids.shape[0])]\n            out: dict[str, Any] = {}\n            for k in (\"m\", \"m_logits\", \"m_mean_logit\", \"mass\", \"R\", \"R0\", \"normed_actual\"):\n                out[k] = np.concatenate([p[k] for p in parts], 0)\n            out[\"first_tok\"] = torch.cat([p[\"first_tok\"] for p in parts], 0)\n            out[\"cache\"] = parts[0][\"cache\"] if len(parts) == 1 else None  # not reusable after per-item retry\n            out[\"full\"] = {l: torch.cat([p[\"full\"][l] for p in parts], 0) for l in full_layers}\n            return out\n\n    def late_caps(self, store: dict) -> list:\n        return [(l, self._cap(store, l)) for l in self.B_late]\n\n    @torch.no_grad()\n    def last_call(self, b: Batch, cache, fns: list, capture_late: bool = True) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray | None]:\n        st: dict[int, torch.Tensor] = {}\n        cf = self.late_caps(st) if capture_late else []\n        assert cache.get_seq_length() == b.T - 1, f\"stale KV cache: length {cache.get_seq_length()} != T-1={b.T - 1}\"\n        with hooks(self.layers, list(fns) + cf):\n            self.model(input_ids=b.ids[:, -1:], attention_mask=b.mask, position_ids=b.pos[:, -1:],\n                       past_key_values=cache, use_cache=True, logits_to_keep=1)\n        cache.crop(b.T - 1)\n        m = self.margin_now().detach().cpu().numpy().astype(np.float64)\n        late = torch.stack([st[l] for l in self.B_late], 1).detach().cpu().numpy() if capture_late else None\n        return m, late\n\n    @torch.no_grad()\n    def skip_call(self, b: Batch, j: int, h_in: torch.Tensor, fns: list,\n                  capture_late: bool = True) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray | None]:\n        st: dict[int, torch.Tensor] = {}\n        cf = self.late_caps(st) if capture_late else []\n        with skip_below(self.layers, j, h_in, self.out_is_tuple), hooks(self.layers, list(fns) + cf):\n            self.model(input_ids=b.ids, attention_mask=b.mask, position_ids=b.pos, use_cache=False, logits_to_keep=1)\n        m = self.margin_now().detach().cpu().numpy().astype(np.float64)\n        late = torch.stack([st[l] for l in self.B_late], 1).detach().cpu().numpy() if capture_late else None\n        return m, late\n\n    @torch.no_grad()\n    def generate(self, b: Batch, base: dict, n_new: int, n_capture: int = 8,\n                extra_fns: list | None = None) -> tuple[list[str], np.ndarray, list[list[int]]]:\n        cache = base[\"cache\"]\n        B = b.ids.shape[0]\n        if cache is not None and cache.get_seq_length() == b.T - 1:\n            with hooks(self.layers, list(extra_fns or [])):\n                o0 = self.model(input_ids=b.ids[:, -1:], attention_mask=b.mask, position_ids=b.pos[:, -1:],\n                                past_key_values=cache, use_cache=True, logits_to_keep=1)\n            y = o0.logits[:, -1, :].argmax(-1)\n        else:\n            y = base[\"first_tok\"].clone()\n        toks = [y]\n        mask = b.mask\n        traj = []\n        n_calls = max(n_new - 1, n_capture)\n        for t in range(1, n_calls + 1):\n            mask = torch.cat([mask, torch.ones(B, 1, dtype=mask.dtype, device=mask.device)], 1)\n            st: dict[int, torch.Tensor] = {}\n            fns = list(extra_fns or []) + (self.late_caps(st) if t <= n_capture else [])\n            with hooks(self.layers, fns):\n                o = self.model(input_ids=y[:, None], attention_mask=mask, position_ids=b.pos[:, -1:] + t,\n                               past_key_values=cache, use_cache=True, logits_to_keep=1)\n            if t <= n_capture:\n                traj.append(torch.stack([st[l] for l in self.B_late], 1).detach().cpu().numpy())\n            y = o.logits[:, -1, :].argmax(-1)\n            if len(toks) < n_new:\n                toks.append(y)\n        cache.crop(b.T - 1)\n        T = torch.stack(toks, 1)\n        texts, ids_out = [], []\n        eos = set(self.eos_ids.tolist())\n        for i in range(B):\n            ids = T[i].tolist()\n            cut = next((k for k, t_ in enumerate(ids) if t_ in eos), len(ids))\n            ids_out.append(ids[:cut])\n            texts.append(self.tok.decode(ids[:cut], skip_special_tokens=True))\n        return texts, np.stack(traj, 1), ids_out  # traj (B, n_capture, n_late, d)\n\n    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------- shared steering pass (C1 & C1n)\n    def _steer_pass(self, b: Batch, base: dict, dirs_bl: dict[int, np.ndarray], eps: float, s: float,\n                    rows_eval: list[int] | None = None, extra_fns: list | None = None,\n                    capture_late: bool = True) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray | None]:\n        \"\"\"s*eps*||R_i,l||*dirs_bl[l][i] added at the last prompt token of every layer in dirs_bl, for\n        rows_eval only. c1_block's C1 and c1n_block's C1n_* / pull_even share this EXACT arithmetic.\"\"\"\n        R = base[\"R\"]\n        rows_eval = rows_eval if rows_eval is not None else list(range(len(R)))\n        off_rows = [i for i in range(len(R)) if i not in rows_eval]\n        fns = list(extra_fns or [])\n        for l, dvec in dirs_bl.items():\n            nrm = np.linalg.norm(R[:, l, :], axis=1)\n            vec = torch.from_numpy((s * eps * nrm[:, None] * dvec).astype(np.float32)).to(DEVICE)\n            if off_rows:\n                vec[off_rows] = 0.0\n\n            def f(h: torch.Tensor, _v=vec):\n                h = h.clone()\n                h[:, -1, :] = (h[:, -1, :].float() + _v).to(h.dtype)\n                return h\n            fns.append((l, f))\n        try:\n            return self.last_call(b, base[\"cache\"], fns, capture_late=capture_late)\n        except torch.cuda.OutOfMemoryError:\n            logger.warning(f\"{self.repo}: OOM in steer pass, retrying once after cache clear\")\n            torch.cuda.empty_cache()\n            self.flags.append({\"code\": \"OOM_AT_10GB\", \"detail\": \"steer pass retried after empty_cache \"\n                               \"(per-item retry is not possible here: last_call reuses the shared \"\n                               \"16-row KV cache built once per condition)\"})\n            return self.last_call(b, base[\"cache\"], fns, capture_late=capture_late)\n\n    def c1_block(self, b: Batch, base: dict, D: np.ndarray, rows_eval: list[int], eps_list: list[float],\n                rb: np.ndarray | None, null_dirs: np.ndarray | None) -> dict:\n        \"\"\"C1 finite-difference gain. D (16, L, d) per-item directions; norms from base R.\"\"\"\n        m0 = base[\"m\"]\n        R = base[\"R\"]\n        res: dict[str, Any] = {\"eps\": {}}\n        late_store = {}\n        dirs = {l: D[:, l, :] for l in self.B_mid}\n        for eps in eps_list:\n            mp, lp = self._steer_pass(b, base, dirs, eps, +1.0, rows_eval)\n            mm, lm = self._steer_pass(b, base, dirs, eps, -1.0, rows_eval)\n            res[\"eps\"][eps] = {\"m_plus\": mp, \"m_minus\": mm}\n            late_store[eps] = (lp, lm)\n        res[\"late_store\"] = late_store\n        ev = np.array(rows_eval)\n        s_m = sd(m0[ev])\n        g = (res[\"eps\"][EPS0][\"m_plus\"] - res[\"eps\"][EPS0][\"m_minus\"]) / (2 * EPS0)\n        res[\"g_items\"] = g\n        res[\"sd_margin\"] = s_m\n        raw = float(np.mean(g[ev]))\n        res[\"raw\"] = raw\n        und = (not math.isfinite(s_m)) or s_m < SD_FLOOR\n        res[\"value\"] = None if und else raw / s_m\n        res[\"undefined_reason\"] = f\"H5 variance floor: SD(margin)={s_m:.3f} < {SD_FLOOR}\" if und else None\n        hi = [i for i in ev if IS_HARM[i]]\n        ti = [i for i in ev if not IS_HARM[i]]\n        res[\"harm_only\"] = None if und else float(np.mean(g[hi])) / s_m\n        res[\"twin_only\"] = None if und else float(np.mean(g[ti])) / s_m\n        lin = {}\n        for eps in eps_list:\n            dpi = res[\"eps\"][eps][\"m_plus\"][ev] - m0[ev]\n            dmi = m0[ev] - res[\"eps\"][eps][\"m_minus\"][ev]\n            dp, dm = float(np.mean(np.abs(dpi))), float(np.mean(np.abs(dmi)))\n            rel = abs(dp - dm) / max(dp, dm, 1e-9)\n            det = max(dp, dm) >= 0.05\n            lin[str(eps)] = {\"d_plus_abs\": dp, \"d_minus_abs\": dm, \"rel_asym\": rel,\n                             \"linear\": (rel < 0.2) if det else None, \"undetermined_below_noise\": not det,\n                             \"gain\": float(np.mean((res[\"eps\"][eps][\"m_plus\"][ev] - res[\"eps\"][eps][\"m_minus\"][ev])\n                                                   / (2 * eps)))}\n        res[\"linearity\"] = lin\n        res[\"linear_range_eps\"] = [float(e) for e in eps_list if lin[str(e)][\"linear\"] is True]\n        res[\"nonlinear_at_primary\"] = (lin.get(str(EPS0), {}).get(\"linear\") is False)\n        if rb is not None:\n            lp, lm = late_store.get(EPS0, (None, None))\n            if lp is not None:\n                proj = lambda Z: np.mean(np.einsum(\"bld,ld->bl\", Z, rb[self.B_late]), 1)  # noqa: E731\n                gl = (proj(lp) - proj(lm)) / (2 * EPS0)\n                p0 = np.mean(np.einsum(\"bld,ld->bl\", R[:, self.B_late, :], rb[self.B_late]), 1)\n                sp = sd(p0[ev])\n                res[\"late\"] = float(np.mean(gl[ev])) / sp if sp > 0 else None\n        if null_dirs is not None:\n            nv = []\n            for k in range(null_dirs.shape[1]):\n                dk = {l: np.repeat(null_dirs[li, k][None, :], len(R), 0) for li, l in enumerate(self.B_mid)}\n                mp, _ = self._steer_pass(b, base, dk, EPS0, +1.0, rows_eval, capture_late=False)\n                mm, _ = self._steer_pass(b, base, dk, EPS0, -1.0, rows_eval, capture_late=False)\n                gk = (mp - mm) / (2 * EPS0)\n                nv.append(float(np.mean(gk[ev])) / s_m if not und else float(np.mean(gk[ev])))\n            res[\"null_values\"] = nv\n            res[\"null_p95\"] = float(np.percentile(nv, 95))\n        return res\n\n    def c2_block(self, b: Batch, j: int, h_in: torch.Tensor, D: np.ndarray, m_ref: np.ndarray,\n                null_dirs: np.ndarray | None) -> dict:\n        \"\"\"C2 two-sided self-ablation sensitivity.\"\"\"\n        def abl(dirs_bl: dict[int, np.ndarray]) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:\n            fns = []\n            for l in self.B_mid:\n                U = torch.from_numpy(dirs_bl[l].astype(np.float32)).to(DEVICE)\n\n                def f(h: torch.Tensor, _U=U):\n                    hf = h.float()\n                    pr = (hf * _U[:, None, :]).sum(-1, keepdim=True)\n                    return (hf - pr * _U[:, None, :]).to(h.dtype)\n                fns.append((l, f))\n            return self.skip_call(b, j, h_in, fns)\n        n = b.ids.shape[0]\n        harm = np.array([bool(IS_HARM[i]) for i in b.item_idx])\n        m_abl, late_abl = abl({l: D[:, l, :] for l in self.B_mid})\n        drop = m_ref - m_abl\n        s_m = sd(m_ref)\n        und = (not math.isfinite(s_m)) or s_m < SD_FLOOR\n        raw = float(drop[harm].mean() - drop[~harm].mean())\n        res = {\"m_abl\": m_abl, \"late_abl\": late_abl, \"drop\": drop, \"raw\": raw, \"sd_margin\": s_m,\n              \"value\": None if und else raw / s_m,\n              \"undefined_reason\": f\"H5 variance floor: SD(margin)={s_m:.3f} < {SD_FLOOR}\" if und else None,\n              \"drop_harm_mean\": float(drop[harm].mean()), \"drop_twin_mean\": float(drop[~harm].mean())}\n        if null_dirs is not None:\n            nv = []\n            for k in range(null_dirs.shape[1]):\n                mk, _ = abl({l: np.repeat(null_dirs[li, k][None, :], n, 0) for li, l in enumerate(self.B_mid)})\n                dk = m_ref - mk\n                rk = float(dk[harm].mean() - dk[~harm].mean())\n                nv.append(rk / s_m if not und else rk)\n            res[\"null_values\"] = nv\n            res[\"null_p95\"] = float(np.percentile(nv, 95))\n            v = res[\"value\"]\n            res[\"ratio_to_null_p95\"] = (v / res[\"null_p95\"]) if (v is not None and res[\"null_p95\"] not in (0.0,)) else None\n        return res\n\n    def c11_value(self, traj: np.ndarray, rb: np.ndarray, pairs: list[int]) -> dict:\n        \"\"\"traj (16, 8, n_late, d); rb (L, d).\"\"\"\n        P = np.einsum(\"btld,ld->btl\", traj, rb[self.B_late]).mean(2)  # (16, 8)\n        t = np.arange(1, P.shape[1] + 1)\n        slope = np.array([ols_slope(t, P[i]) for i in range(P.shape[0])])\n        plateau = P[:, 4:8].mean(1)\n        hs = [2 * p for p in pairs]\n        ts = [2 * p + 1 for p in pairs]\n        diff = plateau[hs] - plateau[ts]\n        pooled = math.sqrt((np.var(plateau[hs], ddof=1) + np.var(plateau[ts], ddof=1)) / 2)\n        val = float(np.mean(diff) / pooled) if pooled > 0 else None\n        return {\"value\": val, \"undefined_reason\": None if val is not None else \"zero pooled SD\",\n               \"slope_diff\": float(np.mean(slope[hs] - slope[ts])), \"plateau_harm\": float(np.mean(plateau[hs])),\n               \"plateau_twin\": float(np.mean(plateau[ts])), \"pooled_sd\": pooled, \"proj\": P}\n\n    def bars(self, base: dict, rows: list[int]) -> dict:\n        m, mass = base[\"m\"], base[\"mass\"]\n        h = [i for i in rows if IS_HARM[i]]\n        t = [i for i in rows if not IS_HARM[i]]\n        return {\"logit_gap\": float(m[h].mean() - m[t].mean()), \"refusal_mass\": float(mass[h].mean() - mass[t].mean()),\n               \"logit_gap_level\": float(m[h].mean()), \"refusal_mass_level\": float(mass[h].mean()),\n               \"margin_twin_mean\": float(m[t].mean()), \"sd_margin\": sd(m[rows])}\n\n    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------- C1n: norm-matched random steer\n    def build_Al_hl(self, base_plain: dict, Bc: Batch) -> dict[int, tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]]:\n        Rp = base_plain[\"R\"]\n        out = {}\n        for l in self.B_mid:\n            Hf = base_plain[\"full\"][l].float().detach().cpu().numpy()\n            A = np.concatenate([Hf[i, Bc.mask[i].detach().cpu().numpy().astype(bool)] for i in range(Hf.shape[0])], 0)\n            A = massive_filter(A.astype(np.float32))\n            h_l = unit(Rp[HARM_IDX, l].mean(0) - Rp[TWIN_IDX, l].mean(0)).astype(np.float32)\n            out[l] = (A, h_l)\n        return out\n\n    def build_c1n_dirs(self, Al_hl: dict[int, tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]]) -> tuple[dict[int, np.ndarray], list[dict]]:\n        \"\"\"U[l] (20, d): the k-th row is u_{k,l}, drawn IN ORDER over B_mid layers from rng_k =\n        default_rng(20260921+100+k) (PREREG seeds.C1n_steer_k), so each seed spends its own random\n        stream across all 3 B_mid layers exactly as the plan specifies.\"\"\"\n        U = {l: np.zeros((N_RAND, self.d), np.float32) for l in self.B_mid}\n        infos = []\n        for k in range(N_RAND):\n            rng_k = np.random.default_rng(20260921 + 100 + k)\n            info_k = {}\n            for l in self.B_mid:\n                A_l, h_l = Al_hl[l]\n                v, info = aniso_random_dirs(A_l, h_l, 1, rng_k)\n                U[l][k] = v[0]\n                info_k[str(l)] = info\n            infos.append(info_k)\n        return U, infos\n\n    def c1n_block(self, b: Batch, base: dict, c1_harm: dict, U: dict[int, np.ndarray], eps_list: list[float],\n                 rows_eval: list[int] | None = None) -> dict:\n        \"\"\"Returns per-eps dicts of {cd_harm, cd_rand[], os_harm_raw, os_rand_raw[], pull_even_harm_raw,\n        pull_even_rand_raw[]}; c1_harm is the SAME condition's already-computed c1_block() result for\n        the real harm direction (so the harm-direction m_plus/m_minus are not recomputed).\"\"\"\n        rows_eval = rows_eval if rows_eval is not None else list(range(2 * NP))\n        ev = np.array(rows_eval)\n        m0 = base[\"m\"]\n        s_m = sd(m0[ev])\n        hi = [i for i in ev if IS_HARM[i]]\n        ti = [i for i in ev if not IS_HARM[i]]\n\n        def onesided(mp: np.ndarray, eps: float, idx: list[int]) -> float:\n            return float(np.mean((mp[idx] - m0[idx]) / eps))\n\n        def pulleven(mp: np.ndarray, mm: np.ndarray, eps: float) -> float:\n            return float(np.mean((mp[ev] + mm[ev] - 2 * m0[ev]) / (eps * eps)))\n\n        n_seeds_used = N_RAND\n        per_eps: dict[float, dict] = {}\n        seeds_broke = False\n        for eps in eps_list:\n            eps_data = c1_harm[\"eps\"].get(eps)\n            if eps_data is None:\n                mp_h, _ = self._steer_pass(b, base, {l: c1_harm[\"_D\"][:, l, :] for l in self.B_mid}, eps, +1.0,\n                                           rows_eval, capture_late=False)\n                mm_h, _ = self._steer_pass(b, base, {l: c1_harm[\"_D\"][:, l, :] for l in self.B_mid}, eps, -1.0,\n                                           rows_eval, capture_late=False)\n            else:\n                mp_h, mm_h = eps_data[\"m_plus\"], eps_data[\"m_minus\"]\n            cd_h = float(np.mean(((mp_h - mm_h) / (2 * eps))[ev])) / s_m if s_m > 0 else None\n            os_h = onesided(mp_h, eps, hi) - onesided(mp_h, eps, ti)\n            pe_h = pulleven(mp_h, mm_h, eps)\n            cd_rand, os_rand, pe_rand = [], [], []\n            for k in range(n_seeds_used):\n                dirs_bl = {l: np.repeat(U[l][k][None, :], 2 * NP, 0) for l in self.B_mid}\n                try:\n                    mp_k, _ = self._steer_pass(b, base, dirs_bl, eps, +1.0, rows_eval, capture_late=False)\n                    mm_k, _ = self._steer_pass(b, base, dirs_bl, eps, -1.0, rows_eval, capture_late=False)\n                except torch.cuda.OutOfMemoryError:\n                    seeds_broke = True\n                    break\n                g_k = (mp_k - mm_k) / (2 * eps)\n                cd_rand.append(float(np.mean(g_k[ev])) / s_m if s_m > 0 else float(np.mean(g_k[ev])))\n                os_rand.append(onesided(mp_k, eps, hi) - onesided(mp_k, eps, ti))\n                pe_rand.append(pulleven(mp_k, mm_k, eps))\n            per_eps[eps] = {\"cd_harm\": cd_h, \"cd_rand\": cd_rand, \"os_harm_raw\": os_h, \"os_rand_raw\": os_rand,\n                            \"pull_even_harm_raw\": pe_h, \"pull_even_rand_raw\": pe_rand}\n            if seeds_broke:\n                break\n        if seeds_broke:\n            self.flags.append({\"code\": \"C1N_SEEDS_REDUCED\", \"detail\": f\"OOM during the seed loop; \"\n                               f\"{len(per_eps[eps_list[0]]['cd_rand'])}/{N_RAND} seeds completed\"})\n        return {\"per_eps\": per_eps, \"s_m\": s_m, \"n_seeds_used\": len(per_eps.get(eps_list[0], {}).get(\"cd_rand\", []))}\n\n    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------- C6 / C10 / C12 / C13 / C15 wiring\n    def compute_w_eff(self, base_plain: dict) -> dict:\n        R_L = base_plain[\"R\"][:, self.L - 1, :].astype(np.float64)\n        return w_eff_and_variant(R_L, base_plain[\"normed_actual\"], self.u_vec, self.norm_w, self.norm_eps)\n\n    def margin_of_real_norm(self, H: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:\n        \"\"\"Apply the ACTUAL final-norm module to arbitrary (n, d) residuals (real logit lens, no\n        linear approximation) and return the logsumexp refuse/comply margin. Used only by C6_lens.\"\"\"\n        with torch.no_grad():\n            t = torch.from_numpy(H.astype(np.float32)).to(DEVICE, self.model.dtype)\n            normed = self.norm_module(t).float()\n            z = normed @ self.W_rc.T\n            m = torch.logsumexp(z[:, :self.n_ref], -1) - torch.logsumexp(z[:, self.n_ref:], -1)\n        return m.detach().cpu().numpy().astype(np.float64)\n\n    def rms_final(self, base: dict) -> np.ndarray:\n        R_L = base[\"R\"][:, self.L - 1, :].astype(np.float64)\n        return np.sqrt(np.mean(R_L ** 2, axis=1) + self.norm_eps)\n\n\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- Batch helpers (item tracking)\ndef _with_items(self: Batch, items: list[int]) -> Batch:\n    nb = self.rows(items)\n    nb.item_idx = list(items)\n    return nb\n\n\nBatch.with_items = _with_items  # type: ignore[attr-defined]\n_orig_rows = Batch.rows\n\n\ndef _rows_tracked(self: Batch, idx):\n    nb = _orig_rows(self, idx)\n    base_idx = getattr(self, \"item_idx\", list(range(self.ids.shape[0])))\n    nb.item_idx = [base_idx[int(i)] for i in idx]\n    return nb\n\n\nBatch.rows = _rows_tracked  # type: ignore[assignment]\n\n\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- per-condition new blocks\ndef new_blocks_for_condition(mr: ModelRun, base: dict, wrap_base: dict | None, w_eff_info: dict,\n                             pairs: list[int], folds: list[list[int]], U: dict[int, np.ndarray] | None,\n                             full: bool) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"C6, C10, C12, C13, C15 for ONE condition's already-computed base pass (+ its wrap pass for C13).\n    `full` gates the expensive null computations (skipped for offset-control reads, which only need\n    the point estimates per the plan's reduced offset set).\"\"\"\n    R, R0, m = base[\"R\"], base[\"R0\"], base[\"m\"]\n    is_harm_sub = IS_HARM\n    out: dict[str, Any] = {}\n    # C6\n    rmsf = mr.rms_final(base)\n    c6 = c6_block(R, R0, w_eff_info[\"w_eff\"], rmsf, base[\"m_mean_logit\"], base[\"m_logits\"], pairs, folds)\n    out[\"c6\"] = c6\n    c6_fallback = c6[\"corr_meanlogit\"] is None or c6[\"corr_meanlogit\"] < 0.99\n    m_embed = mr.margin_of_real_norm(R0)\n    m_layers = np.stack([mr.margin_of_real_norm(R[:, l, :]) for l in range(R.shape[1])], 1)\n    c6lens = c6_lens_block(m_embed, m_layers, pairs, folds)\n    out[\"c6_lens\"] = c6lens\n    out[\"c6_lens_fallback\"] = bool(c6_fallback)\n    # C10\n    Dh = cf_harm_dirs(R, pairs, folds)\n    a_l, d_l = c10_curve(R, Dh, w_eff_info[\"w_eff\"], mr.norm_eps, is_harm_sub)\n    c10v, fa, fd, z = c10_value(a_l, d_l)\n    out[\"c10\"] = {\"value\": c10v, \"a_l\": a_l, \"d_l\": d_l, \"first_a75\": fa, \"first_d75\": fd}\n    if full:\n        out[\"c10\"][\"null_values\"] = c10_null(R, w_eff_info[\"w_eff\"], mr.norm_eps, is_harm_sub, pairs, folds,\n                                             20260921 + 300)\n    # C12\n    proj_Lh = np.einsum(\"bd,bd->b\", R[:, mr.L_h, :], Dh[:, mr.L_h, :])\n    pair_of_item = sorted(set(pairs))\n    c12 = c12_block(proj_Lh, is_harm_sub, pair_of_item)\n    out[\"c12\"] = c12\n    if full and U is not None:\n        rand_d = []\n        for k in range(U[mr.L_h].shape[0]):\n            proj_rand = R[:, mr.L_h, :] @ U[mr.L_h][k]\n            rand_d.append(dprime(proj_rand[is_harm_sub], proj_rand[~is_harm_sub]))\n        out[\"c12\"][\"null_values\"] = rand_d\n    # C13 (needs the wrap pass)\n    if wrap_base is not None:\n        proj_wrap_Lh = np.einsum(\"bd,bd->b\", wrap_base[\"R\"][:, mr.L_h, :], Dh[:, mr.L_h, :])\n        c13 = c13_block(proj_Lh, proj_wrap_Lh, m, wrap_base[\"m\"])\n        out[\"c13\"] = c13\n        if full and U is not None:\n            nv = []\n            for k in range(U[mr.L_h].shape[0]):\n                pp = R[:, mr.L_h, :] @ U[mr.L_h][k]\n                pw = wrap_base[\"R\"][:, mr.L_h, :] @ U[mr.L_h][k]\n                denom = np.abs(pp) + np.abs(pw) + sd(pp)\n                nv.append(float(1.0 - np.mean(np.abs(pp - pw) / np.maximum(denom, 1e-9))))\n            out[\"c13\"][\"null_values\"] = nv\n    # C15\n    Xs = [R[:, l, :] for l in mr.B_late]\n    out[\"c15\"] = c15_block(Xs, 20260921 + 600)\n    return out\n\n\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- offset control\ndef offset_control_one(mr: ModelRun, b: Batch, base: dict, pc: dict, c11: dict, rb: np.ndarray,\n                       full_layers: list[int], layer: int, which: str, w_eff_info: dict,\n                       pairs: list[int], folds: list[list[int]]) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"Constant vector c = 2*mean||x|| * u at ALL positions of `layer`; recompute C1, C2, C11, the\n    logit-level bars (IT4 reads) plus C6 (share only), C10, C12, C13_rank and C15_disp (new reads).\"\"\"\n    u = unit(np.random.default_rng(SEED + (99 if which == \"late\" else 199)).standard_normal(mr.d)).astype(np.float32)\n    cn = 2.0 * float(np.mean(np.linalg.norm(base[\"R\"][:, layer, :], axis=1)))\n    cvec = torch.from_numpy(cn * u).to(DEVICE)\n    off = [(layer, lambda h, _v=cvec: (h.float() + _v).to(h.dtype))]\n    bo = mr.base_pass(b, full_layers, extra_fns=off)\n    if bo.get(\"cache\") is not None:\n        bo[\"cache\"].crop(b.T - 1)\n    bars_o = mr.bars(bo, list(range(2 * NP)))\n    D = pc[\"_D\"]\n    c1o = mr.c1_block(b, bo, D, list(range(2 * NP)), [EPS0], rb, None)\n    j = mr.B_mid[0]\n    bi = b.with_items(list(range(2 * NP)))\n    m_ref, _ = mr.skip_call(bi, j, bo[\"full\"][j - 1], off, capture_late=False)\n    c2o = mr.c2_block(bi, j, bo[\"full\"][j - 1], D, m_ref, None)\n    _, traj_o, _ = mr.generate(b, bo, 1, 8, extra_fns=off)\n    c11o = mr.c11_value(traj_o, rb, list(range(NP)))\n    # new reads (point estimate only; no nulls under offset, per the reduced offset set)\n    rmsf_o = mr.rms_final(bo)\n    c6o = c6_block(bo[\"R\"], bo[\"R0\"], w_eff_info[\"w_eff\"], rmsf_o, bo[\"m_mean_logit\"], bo[\"m_logits\"], pairs, folds)\n    Dh_o = cf_harm_dirs(bo[\"R\"], pairs, folds)\n    a_l_o, d_l_o = c10_curve(bo[\"R\"], Dh_o, w_eff_info[\"w_eff\"], mr.norm_eps, IS_HARM)\n    c10o, _, _, _ = c10_value(a_l_o, d_l_o)\n    proj_o = np.einsum(\"bd,bd->b\", bo[\"R\"][:, mr.L_h, :], Dh_o[:, mr.L_h, :])\n    c12o = c12_block(proj_o, IS_HARM, sorted(set(pairs)))\n    wb_o = mr.base_pass(b.rows(list(range(2 * NP))), [], extra_fns=off)  # placeholder overwritten below\n    late_level = lambda R_: float(np.mean(np.einsum(\"bld,ld->bl\", R_[:, mr.B_late, :], rb[mr.B_late])))  # noqa: E731\n    reads = {\n        \"C1\": (pc[\"C1\"][\"value\"], c1o[\"value\"]), \"C2\": (pc[\"C2\"][\"value\"], c2o[\"value\"]),\n        \"C11\": (c11[\"value\"], c11o[\"value\"]), \"logit_gap\": (pc[\"bars\"][\"logit_gap\"], bars_o[\"logit_gap\"]),\n        \"mean_harmful_margin_level\": (pc[\"bars\"][\"logit_gap_level\"], bars_o[\"logit_gap_level\"]),\n        \"mean_late_projection_on_rb_level\": (late_level(base[\"R\"]), late_level(bo[\"R\"])),\n        \"C6_share\": (pc.get(\"_c6_share\"), c6o[\"C6\"]), \"C10\": (pc.get(\"_c10_value\"), c10o),\n        \"C12\": (pc.get(\"_c12_value\"), c12o[\"C12\"]),\n    }\n    out = {\"layer\": layer, \"offset_norm\": cn, \"reads\": {}}\n    for k, (a, bb) in reads.items():\n        a, bb = fnum(a), fnum(bb)\n        rel = (abs(bb - a) / abs(a)) if (a is not None and bb is not None and abs(a) > 1e-9) else None\n        out[\"reads\"][k] = {\"without\": a, \"with\": bb, \"rel_change\": rel,\n                           \"kind\": \"level\" if \"level\" in k else \"across-item/causal\"}\n    return out\n\n\ndef offset_control_c13_rank_disp(mr: ModelRun, cond_prompts_batch: Batch, layer: int, which: str,\n                                 base_plain: dict, Dh_plain: np.ndarray) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"C13_rank and C15_disp under the offset, computed from a fresh offset base pass + wrap pass\n    (kept as a separate small helper so offset_control_one stays readable).\"\"\"\n    u = unit(np.random.default_rng(SEED + (99 if which == \"late\" else 199)).standard_normal(mr.d)).astype(np.float32)\n    cn = 2.0 * float(np.mean(np.linalg.norm(base_plain[\"R\"][:, layer, :], axis=1)))\n    cvec = torch.from_numpy(cn * u).to(DEVICE)\n    off = [(layer, lambda h, _v=cvec: (h.float() + _v).to(h.dtype))]\n    bo = mr.base_pass(cond_prompts_batch, [], extra_fns=off)\n    wb = mr.wrap_batch(\"plain\")\n    wbo = mr.base_pass(wb, [], extra_fns=off)\n    proj_plain = np.einsum(\"bd,bd->b\", bo[\"R\"][:, mr.L_h, :], Dh_plain[:, mr.L_h, :])\n    proj_wrap = np.einsum(\"bd,bd->b\", wbo[\"R\"][:, mr.L_h, :], Dh_plain[:, mr.L_h, :])\n    _, rho, _ = (None, None, None)\n    from scipy.stats import spearmanr\n    if np.std(proj_plain) > 0 and np.std(proj_wrap) > 0:\n        rho = float(spearmanr(proj_plain, proj_wrap).correlation)\n    Xs = [bo[\"R\"][:, l, :] for l in mr.B_late]\n    c15o = c15_block(Xs, 20260921 + 600)\n    return {\"C13_rank\": rho, \"C15_disp\": c15o[\"C15_disp\"]}\n\n\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- assembly\ndef assemble(res: dict, k8: dict, oracle: dict, c11: dict, cond_bars: dict, c1n: dict,\n            new_blocks: dict, offsets: dict, w_eff_info: dict, seconds_own: dict) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"Per candidate: value (plain), pole values, k8, offset_late/offset_mid, nulls, seconds_own.\"\"\"\n    pl = res[\"plain\"]\n    out: dict[str, Any] = {}\n\n    def pole(c: str, key: str, sub: str = \"value\") -> float | None:\n \"C1\"), k8=(k8.get(\"C1\") or {}).get(\"value\"),\n                       offset_late=off_val(\"late\", \"C1\"), offset_mid=off_val(\"mid\", \"C1\"),\n                       **null_stats(pl[\"C1\"].get(\"null_values\"), \"random_direction\"),\n                       seconds_own=seconds_own.get(\"C1\"), raw=pl[\"C1\"][\"raw\"], harm_only=fnum(pl[\"C1\"][\"harm_only\"]),\n                       twin_only=fnum(pl[\"C1\"][\"twin_only\"]))\n    out[\"C2\"] = mkcand(pl[\"C2\"][\"value\"], None, pl[\"C2\"][\"undefined_reason\"], pole_refuse=pole(\"pole_refuse\", \"C2\"),\n            drop_harm_mean=pl[\"C2\"][\"drop_harm_mean\"], drop_twin_mean=pl[\"C2\"][\"drop_twin_mean\"])\n    out[\"C11\"] = mkcand(c11[\"value\"], None, c11[\"undefined_reason\"],\n                        pole_refuse=fnum(res.get(\"pole_refuse\", {}).get(\"C11\", {}).get(\"value\")),\n                        pole_comply=fnum(res.get(\"pole_comply\", {}).get(\"C11\", {}).get(\"value\")),\n                        k8=(k8.get(\"C11\") or {}).get(\"value\"), offset_late=off_val(\"late\", \"C11\"),\n                        offset_mid=off_val(\"mid\", \"C11\"), seconds_own=seconds_own.get(\"C11\"),\n                        slope_diff=c11[\"slope_diff\"], plateau_harm=c11[\"plateau_harm\"], plateau_twin=c11[\"plateau_twin\"])\n    out[\"logit_gap\"] = mkcand(pl[\"bars\"][\"logit_gap\"], False, None, pole_refuse=cond_bars.get(\"pole_refuse\", {}).get(\"logit_gap\"),\n                              pole_comply=cond_bars.get(\"pole_comply\", {}).get(\"logit_gap\"),\n                              k8=(k8.get(\"bars\") or {}).get(\"logit_gap\"), offset_late=off_val(\"late\", \"logit_gap\"),\n                              offset_mid=off_val(\"mid\", \"logit_gap\"))\n    out[\"refusal_mass\"] = pole_comply=cond_bars.get(\"pole_comply\", {}).get(\"refusal_mass\"),\n                                 k8=(k8.get(\"bars\") or {}).get(\"refusal_mass\"))\n    out[\"logit_gap_level\"] =  pole_comply=cond_bars.get(\"pole_comply\", {}).get(\"logit_gap_level\"),\n                                    k8=(k8.get(\"bars\") or {}).get(\"logit_gap_level\"))\n    out[\"refusal_mass_level\"] = C1n_cd / C1n_os / pull_even diagnostics\n    e0 = EPS0\n    plain_eps = c1n[\"plain\"][\"per_eps\"]\n    cd_h0, cd_rand0 = plain_eps[e0][\"cd_harm\"], plain_eps[e0][\"cd_rand\"]\n    os_h0_raw, import json, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0, ".")
import torch
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer
import ams_lib

total = torch.cuda.get_device_properties(0).total_memory
torch.cuda.set_per_process_memory_fraction(min(10.0/(total/1e9), 0.99), 0)

repo = "Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct"
tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(repo)
if tok.pad_token is None:
    tok.pad_token = tok.eos_token
model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(repo, dtype=torch.bfloat16).to("cuda")
model.eval()

# load real screen16
import pathlib
data_path = pathlib.Path("../../../iter_3/gen_art/gen_art_dataset_1/screen16.jsonl")
rows = [json.loads(l) for l in data_path.read_text().splitlines() if l.strip()]
by_pair = {}
for r in rows:
    by_pair.setdefault(r["pair_id"], []).append(r)
screen16_prompts, screen16_is_harm, pairs = [], [], []
pid = 0
for _pid, items in by_pair.items():
    if len(items) != 2: continue
    for it in items:
        screen16_prompts.append(it["prompt"]); screen16_is_harm.append(it["side"]=="harmful")
    pairs.append(pid); pid += 1

t0 = time.time()
out = ams_lib.run_ams(model=model, tok=tok, repo=repo, template_mode="raw", layers=None,
    device="cuda", screen16_prompts=screen16_prompts, screen16_is_harm=screen16_is_harm,
    pairs=pairs, folds=[], seed=20260921, budget_s=180.0)
print("WALL", time.time()-t0)
with open("scratch/ams_run_report.json","w") as f:
    json.dump(out, f, indent=2, default=str)
print(json.dumps(out["summary"], indent=2))
print("---deviations---")
print(json.dumps(out["deviations"], indent=2))
print("---notes---")
print(json.dumps(out["notes"], indent=2))
print("---extra_args---")
print(json.dumps(out["extra_args"], indent=2))
for cname, c in out["concepts"].items():
    if cname.startswith("_"): continue
    print(f"--- {cname} ---")
    print({k:v for k,v in c.items() if k not in ("null_random","null_perm")})
    print("null_random mean/median/p95:", c["null_random"]["mean"], c["null_random"]["median"], c["null_random"]["p95"])
    print("null_perm mean/median/p95:", c["null_perm"]["mean"], c["null_perm"]["median"], c["null_perm"]["p95"])
del model
torch.cuda.empty_cache()
EOF
```

ext = ActivationExtractor(model, tok, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)

print("batch_size=1 (no padding needed):", dr1.separation, dr1.layer)

# also try with padding_side manually fixed to left, batch_size=8
tok.padding_side = "left"
dr8L, lr8L = ext.extract_direction_with_layer_search(concept.get_positive_prompts(), concept.get_negative_prompts(), search_layers=list(range(9,19)), batch_size=8)
print("batch_size=8 + padding_side=left (bug fixed):", dr8L.separation, dr8L.layer)

NEW: # =====================================================================================================
# S5 timing context. TWO row schemas are supported, auto-detected PER ROW:
#   GPU5 (the real path)   : row["seconds_shared"] (a single float) + row["candidates"][NAME]["seconds_own"]
#   IT4  (--it4-dry-run)   : row["candidate_seconds"][NAME] (own) + row["timing"]["<cond>:base"] for
#                             cond in (plain, pole_refuse, pole_comply), summed, as the shared cost
#                             (mirrors IT4/analyze_live.py:281-283 joined_frame's own 'shared_base_s').
# A candidate with NO own-block at all is read off the shared base pass alone (BASE_PASS_ONLY_IDS), so its
# own cost is 0.0, not missing -- exactly IT4's own convention (analyze_live.py:63,582-583).
# =====================================================================================================
BASE_PASS_ONLY_IDS = ("logit_gap", "refusal_mass")           # GPU5 (C7 is dropped in GPU5)
IT4_BASE_PASS_ONLY_IDS = ("C7", "logit_gap", "refusal_mass")  # IT4 legacy (--it4-dry-run)


def load_s5_timing_context(rows_glob: str, base: Path) -> pd.DataFrame:
    recs = []
    paths = sorted(base.glob(rows_glob))
    for p in paths:
        try:
            row = json.loads(p.read_text())
        except (json.JSONDecodeError, OSError) as e:
            logger.warning(f"S5 timing: skip unreadable row {p}: {e}")
            continue
        compute = row.get("compute") or {}
        recs.append({"repo": row.get("repo"), "n_params": row.get("n_params"),
                     "stratum": row.get("stratum"), "device": compute.get("device", row.get("device", "cpu")),
                     "raw_row": row})
    return pd.DataFrame.from_records(recs) if recs else pd.DataFrame(
        columns=["repo", "n_params", "stratum", "device", "raw_row"])


def _row_candidate_timing(row: dict, cid: str) -> tuple[float | None, float | None, bool]:
    """Return (own_seconds, shared_seconds, schema_has_timing_fields) for one row + candidate id, whichever
    of the two schemas the row uses. schema_has_timing_fields=False means the row carries NEITHER
    seconds_shared/seconds_own NOR candidate_seconds/timing at all (a genuinely un-timed row, e.g. an old
    fixture) -- distinct from `own is None` with schema_has_timing_fields=True, which means this specific
    candidate's own cost was never recorded even though the row DOES carry timing for other candidates."""
    candidates = row.get("candidates") or {}
    gpu5_native = ("seconds_shared" in row) or any(
        isinstance(cd, dict) and "seconds_own" in cd for cd in candidates.values())
    if gpu5_native:
        cd = candidates.get(cid, {}) or {}
        own = cd.get("seconds_own")
        if own is None and cid in BASE_PASS_ONLY_IDS:
            own = 0.0
        return own, row.get("seconds_shared"), True
    csecs, timing = row.get("candidate_seconds"), row.get("timing")
    if csecs is not None or timing is not None:
        own = (csecs or {}).get(cid)
        if own is None and cid in IT4_BASE_PASS_ONLY_IDS:
            own = 0.0
        shared = (sum(float((timing or {}).get(f"{c}:base", 0.0) or 0.0)
                     for c in ("plain", "pole_refuse", "pole_comply")) if timing is not None else None)
        return own, shared, True
    return None, None, False

NEW: def s5_check(cid: str, timing_df: pd.DataFrame, k_prompts: int) -> dict:
    """pass=None (assessable=False) means N/A -- a genuinely un-timed row schema, NEVER a failed gate. pass
    =False is a real gap: the row schema DOES carry timing, but this candidate exceeded the cap, or its own
    cost was never recorded despite other candidates in the same rows being timed. k<=16 always holds here
    (SCREEN16 is fixed at 16 items; k8 is a PRESENTATION variant of the SAME 16 items, i.e. 16 items x 2
    presentations, per PREREG S5, printed as such -- never counted as a second, larger item set)."""
    k_ok = bool(k_prompts <= 16)
    k_note = (f"k={k_prompts} items <= 16: {'ok' if k_ok else 'FAIL'} (the k8/wrapped-pole conditions are "
             f"PRESENTATION variants of the same 16 items -- 16 items x multiple presentations, not extra items)")
    if timing_df.empty:
        return {"pass": None, "assessable": False, "n_4B_gpu_rows": 0, "k_prompts": k_prompts, "k_le_16": k_ok,
               "reason": f"n/a (no timing yet): no rows/*.json read. {k_note}"}
    chat = timing_df[timing_df["stratum"] == "chat"] if "stratum" in timing_df.columns else timing_df
    npar = pd.to_numeric(chat["n_params"], errors="coerce")
    rows4b = chat[(chat["device"] == "cuda") & (npar >= S5_N_PARAMS_4B_FLOOR)]
    n_rows = int(len(rows4b))
    if n_rows == 0:
        return {"pass": None, "assessable": False, "n_4B_gpu_rows": 0, "k_prompts": k_prompts, "k_le_16": k_ok,
               "reason": f"n/a (no timing yet): no ~4B model measured on GPU. {k_note}"}
    secs, missing = [], []
    any_schema = False
    for _, r in rows4b.iterrows():
        own, shared, has_schema = _row_candidate_timing(r["raw_row"], cid)
        any_schema = any_schema or has_schema
        if own is None:
            missing.append(r["repo"])
            continue
        secs.append(float(own) + float(shared or 0.0))
    if not secs:
        if not any_schema:
            return {"pass": None, "assessable": False, "n_4B_gpu_rows": n_rows, "k_prompts": k_prompts,
                   "k_le_16": k_ok, "reason": f"n/a (no timing yet): this row schema carries no timing "
                   f"fields at all for {n_rows} ~4B GPU row(s) yet. {k_note}"}
        return {"pass": False, "assessable": True, "n_4B_gpu_rows": n_rows, "k_prompts": k_prompts,
               "k_le_16": k_ok, "reason": f"REAL GAP: the row schema carries timing fields, but "
               f"{cid}'s own seconds were never recorded on any of the {n_rows} ~4B GPU row(s). {k_note}"}
    max_s = float(np.max(secs))
    s5_pass = bool(k_ok and max_s < S5_TIME_LIMIT_S and not missing)
    return {"pass": s5_pass, "assessable": True, "n_4B_gpu_rows": n_rows, "n_timed": len(secs),
           "max_s": max_s, "median_s": float(np.median(secs)), "k_prompts": k_prompts, "k_le_16": k_ok,
           "missing_seconds_repos": missing,
           "reason": f"{k_note}; {len(secs)}/{n_rows} ~4B GPU row(s) timed: max={max_s:.1f}s "
                    f"(limit <{S5_TIME_LIMIT_S:.0f}s, own + shared base passes)"
                    + (f"; MISSING on {len(missing)}/{n_rows}: {', '.join(missing)}" if missing else "")}

File: /ai-inventor/aii_data/runs/run_fcYd_7ruOwtm/3_invention_loop/iter_5/gen_art/gen_art_experiment_1/make_results.py

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""RESULTS.md, counts first (plan Step 9).

Reads analysis_gpu.json, coverage_gpu5.json, ams_tier1.json, freeze_certificate.json, values_setA.sha256,
skips.json, spend.json, DEVIATIONS.json and rows/. Writes RESULTS.md. Pure bookkeeping: every number is copied
from those files, nothing is recomputed here, so RESULTS.md can never disagree with the analysis.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import glob
import json
from pathlib import Path

import blind_guard

blind_guard.install()

WS = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROWS = WS / "rows"


def j(name: str, default=None):  # noqa: ANN001, ANN201
    p = WS / name
    if not p.exists():
        return default
    try:
        return json.loads(p.read_text())
    except json.JSONDecodeError:
        return default


def f(x, nd=3):  # noqa: ANN001, ANN201
    try:
        v = float(x)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return "–"
    return f"{v:.{nd}f}"


def ci(b: dict | None, nd=3) -> str:  # noqa: ANN001
    if not isinstance(b, dict):
        return "–"
    if "ci_lo" in b:
        return f"{f(b.get('point'), nd)} [{f(b.get('ci_lo'), nd)}, {f(b.get('ci_hi'), nd)}]"
    if "ci_lo_one_sided" in b:
        return f"{f(b.get('point'), nd)} (5% bound {f(b.get('ci_lo_one_sided'), nd)})"
    return f(b.get("point"), nd)


ORDER = ["C1", "C1n_cd", "C1n_os", "C2", "C6", "C6_insample", "C6_lens", "C10", "C12", "C12r", "C13", "C13_rank",
         "C15_erank", "C15_disp", "C11", "AMS_published", "AMS_pkg", "AMS_mean3", "AMS_cf_layer", "AMS_cf_sweep",
         "AMS_screen16", "logit_gap", "refusal_mass", "C13_logit", "S2_screen16", "keyword_probe",
         "family_only", "size_only"]
INTERNAL = {"C1", "C1n_cd", "C1n_os", "C2", "C6", "C6_insample", "C6_lens", "C10", "C12", "C12r", "C13",
            "C13_rank", "C15_erank", "C15_disp", "C11", "AMS_published", "AMS_pkg", "AMS_mean3", "AMS_cf_layer",
            "AMS_cf_sweep", "AMS_screen16"}


def main() -> None:
    an = j("analysis_gpu.json", {}) or {}
    cov = j("coverage_gpu5.json", {}) or {}
    ams = j("ams_tier1.json", {}) or {}
    cert = j("freeze_certificate.json", {}) or {}
    devs = (j("DEVIATIONS.json", {}) or {}).get("entries", [])
    skips = j("skips.json", []) or []
    spend = j("spend.json", {}) or {}
    prereg_hash = (WS / "PREREG_hash.txt").read_text().split()[0] if (WS / "PREREG_hash.txt").exists() else "–"
    rows = [json.loads(Path(p).read_text()) for p in sorted(glob.glob(str(ROWS / "*.json")))]
    cands = an.get("candidates") or {}
    ps = an.get("panel_summary") or {}
    L = []
    A = L.append
    A("# RESULTS — iteration-5 GPU tier (C1n random-steer control, five new activation reads, AMS incumbent)\n")
    A(f"PREREG sha256 `{prereg_hash}` (frozen before any value was computed). "
      f"Set A values sha256 `{(cert.get('values_setA_sha256') or '–')}`, frozen {cert.get('frozen_utc', '–')}.\n")

    # ---------------- counts first
    A("## 1. Counts\n")
    n_graded = sum(1 for r in rows if r.get("graded"))
    setA = set((j("PREREG.json", {}) or {}).get("panel", {}).get("setA", []))
    n_setA = sum(1 for r in rows if r["repo"] in setA)
    n_base = sum(1 for r in rows if r.get("stratum") == "base")
    ncand = {len(r.get("candidates") or {}) for r in rows}
    secs = [r.get("wall_s") for r in rows if r.get("wall_s")]
    peaks = [(r.get("compute") or {}).get("vram_peak_gb") for r in rows]
    peaks = [p for p in peaks if p]
    A(f"- models measured: **{len(rows)}** = {n_graded} graded + {n_setA} Set A + {n_base} base "
      f"(panel {cov.get('n_panel', '–')}; coverage ok {cov.get('n_ok', '–')}, incomplete {cov.get('n_incomplete', '–')}, "
      f"skipped {cov.get('n_skipped', '–')}, missing {cov.get('n_missing', '–')})")
    A(f"- candidates per model: {sorted(ncand)} (including every bar and variant key)")
    A(f"- wall seconds per model: min {f(min(secs), 1) if secs else '–'}, median "
      f"{f(sorted(secs)[len(secs) // 2], 1) if secs else '–'}, max {f(max(secs), 1) if secs else '–'}")
    A(f"- VRAM peak across models: max {f(max(peaks)) if peaks else '–'} GB (cap 10.0 GB, never raised above 10.5)")
    A(f"- graded analysis panel: n={ps.get('n_graded', '–')}, families={ps.get('n_families', '–')}, "
      f"lineages={ps.get('n_lineages', '–')}, blanket refusers={ps.get('n_blanket_refusers', '–')}; "
      f"MDE_rho={f((an.get('mde_table') or {}).get('mde_rho'))} at ICC={f((an.get('mde_table') or {}).get('ICC'))}")
    if skips:
        A(f"- skips: " + ", ".join(f"{s['repo']} ({s['code']})" for s in skips))
    A(f"- OpenRouter spend: ${f(spend.get('total_usd'), 4)} (cap $1.00; the stance judge only, cache-first)\n")

    # ---------------- verdict table
    A("## 2. The frozen rule, applied mechanically (target BALANCED, n=23 graded)\n")
    A("| read | internal? | rho_ckpt [lineage CI] | rho_family | partial\\|gap,size (5% bound) | S1 | S2a | S2b | S3 | S4 | S5 | S6 | PASS |")
    A("|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|")
    for k in [x for x in ORDER if x in cands] + [x for x in sorted(cands) if x not in ORDER]:
        c = cands[k]
        rho = ((c.get("rho") or {}).get("BALANCED") or {})
        s1 = c.get("S1") or {}
        def st(key):  # noqa: ANN001, ANN202
            v = c.get(key) or {}
            if isinstance(v, dict) and v.get("applicable") is False:
                return "N/A"
            p = v.get("pass") if isinstance(v, dict) else v
            return "–" if p is None else ("pass" if p else "fail")
        A(f"| {k} | {'yes' if k in INTERNAL else 'BAR'} | {ci(rho.get('rho_ckpt_boot'))} | {f(rho.get('rho_family'))} | "
          f"{ci((s1.get('partial_rho') or {}).get('boot'))} | {st('S1')} | {st('S2a')} | {st('S2b')} | {st('S3')} | "
          f"{st('S4')} | {st('S5')} | {st('S6')} | **{c.get('PASS')}** |")
    A("")
    A(f"**Candidates passing all of S1–S6: {an.get('candidates_passing_all_of_S1_S6') or '[] (none)'}**\n")

    # ---------------- AMS
    A("## 3. The incumbent (AMS Tier-1)\n")
    ok = [v for v in ams.values() if (v or {}).get("status") == "ok"]
    A(f"- AMS ran on {len(ok)}/{len(ams)} measured models; package "
      f"{sorted({(v or {}).get('package') for v in ams.values()}) or '–'}, path "
      f"{sorted({(v or {}).get('path_used') for v in ams.values()}) or '–'}")
    h2h = an.get("extra_ams_head_to_head") or {}
    if h2h.get("available"):
        A(f"- paired rho-difference vs C2: {json.dumps(h2h.get('paired_vs_C2'))[:500]}")
        A(f"- paired rho-difference vs the logit gap: {json.dumps(h2h.get('paired_vs_logit_gap'))[:500]}")
        if h2h.get("verdict_counts"):
            A(f"- verdict counts by class: {json.dumps(h2h['verdict_counts'])}")
        if h2h.get("gap_distribution"):
            A(f"- in-sample minus cross-fitted gap: {json.dumps(h2h['gap_distribution'])}")
    else:
        A(f"- head-to-head not available: {h2h.get('reason')}")
    A("")

    # ---------------- Malla
    A("## 4. Malla check — is C1 just the content-free pull toward refusal?\n")
    ml = an.get("extra_malla_check") or {}
    if ml.get("available"):
        for k, v in ml.items():
            if k != "available":
                A(f"- {k}: {json.dumps(v)[:400]}")
    else:
        A(f"- not available: {ml.get('reason')}")
    A("")

    # ---------------- never-gates
    A("## 5. Reported, never a gate\n")
    A("| read | detect-vs-grade rho (n) | exceed-indicator point-biserial | increment over the 16-prompt judged probe |")
    A("|---|---|---|---|")
    for k in [x for x in ORDER if x in cands]:
        c = cands[k]
        dg = c.get("detect_vs_grade") or {}
        inc = c.get("increment_over_behaviour") or {}
        A(f"| {k} | {f(dg.get('rho'))} (n={dg.get('n', '–')}) | {f(dg.get('point_biserial'))} | "
          f"{ci((inc.get('partial_rho') or {}).get('boot') or inc.get('boot'))} |")
    A("")

    # ---------------- blindness + deviations
    A("## 6. Blindness and deviations\n")
    A(f"- Set A: {cert.get('n_repos_frozen', '–')} checkpoints frozen and hashed before any Set A label existed; "
      f"dataset workspaces seen at freeze: {cert.get('dataset_workspaces_present') or 'NONE'}; "
      f"files named like a label at freeze: {cert.get('any_label_named_file_at_freeze')}")
    A(f"- guard: {json.dumps(cert.get('guard'))}")
    for d in devs:
        A(f"- **{d.get('code')}** — {d.get('detail')}")
    (WS / "RESULTS.md").write_text("\n".join(L) + "\n")
    print(f"RESULTS.md written ({len(L)} lines)")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

import torch

import ams_lib

total = torch.cuda.get_device_properties(0).total_memory

    return m.model.layers

import pathlib
data_path = pathlib.Path("../../../iter_3/gen_art/gen_art_dataset_1/screen16.jsonl")
rows = [json.loads(l) for l in data_path.read_text().splitlines() if l.strip()]
by_pair = {}
for r in rows:
    by_pair.setdefault(r["pair_id"], []).append(r)
PROMPTS, IS_HARM = [], []
PAIR_IDS = list(by_pair.keys())
for _pid in PAIR_IDS:
    items = by_pair[_pid]
    harmful = next(r for r in items if r["side"]=="harmful")
    twin = next(r for r in items if r["side"]=="benign_twin")
    PROMPTS.append(harmful["prompt"]); IS_HARM.append(True)
    PROMPTS.append(twin["prompt"]); IS_HARM.append(False)
NP = len(PAIR_IDS)
import numpy as np
_perm8 = np.random.default_rng(20260921).permutation(NP)
FOLDS = [list(map(int, _perm8[2*k:2*k+2])) for k in range(4)]
pairs_arg = [[2*p, 2*p+1] for p in range(NP)]

t0 = time.time()
out = ams_lib.run_ams(model=model, tok=tok, repo=repo, template_mode="base_plain",
    layers=mr_layers,  # <-- exactly what method.py passes: the ModuleList, not indices
    device="cuda", screen16_prompts=PROMPTS, screen16_is_harm=list(map(bool, IS_HARM)),
    pairs=pairs_arg, folds=FOLDS, seed=20260921, budget_s=180.0)
print("WALL", time.time()-t0, "status", out["status"])
if out["status"] != "ok":
    print(out.get("traceback"))
else:
    print(json.dumps(out["summary"], indent=2))
    print("---deviations---")
    print(json.dumps(out["deviations"], indent=2))
    print("---extra_args---")
    print(json.dumps(out["extra_args"], indent=2))
    print("---harmful_content concept keys---")
    hc = out["concepts"]["harmful_content"]
    print({k: v for k, v in hc.items() if k not in ("null_random","null_perm")})
del model
torch.cuda.empty_cache()
EOF

File: /ai-inventor/aii_data/runs/run_fcYd_7ruOwtm/3_invention_loop/iter_5/gen_art/gen_art_experiment_1/tests/test_analysis.py

"""Unit tests for analyze_gpu.py's numeric core: venv_gpu/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_analysis.py

(i)   partial Spearman against a hand-computed synthetic case (independent closed-form formula, not a
      re-implementation of ols_resid_rank).
(ii)  the lineage bootstrap resamples LINEAGES, not checkpoints (a synthetic case where the two differ:
      one singleton lineage vs. one 9-member lineage -- only lineage-level resampling can ever produce a
      resample of length 1 made of the singleton alone).
(iii) the label-permutation p-value on a known-null (pure-noise) synthetic dataset is uniform-ish
      (p_one_sided > 0.2 at a fixed seed).
(iv)  the S3 orientation flip is actually applied: a candidate with declared orientation -1 is compared
      AFTER sign flip, not on the raw values (a bug that forgot the flip would get part (i) backwards).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import sys
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import pytest

WS = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(WS))

import analyze_gpu as ag  # noqa: E402


# =====================================================================================================
# (i) partial Spearman vs. a hand-computed closed-form partial correlation
# =====================================================================================================
def test_partial_spearman_matches_closed_form_single_covariate():
    rng = np.random.default_rng(12345)
    n = 30
    z = rng.normal(size=n)                       # covariate
    x = 0.6 * z + rng.normal(size=n) * 0.8        # value
    y = 0.5 * z + 0.3 * x + rng.normal(size=n) * 0.7  # target (depends on both z and x)

    got = ag.partial_spearman(x, y, [z])

    # independent closed-form check: classic partial-correlation formula applied to the RANK-transformed
    # variables (ols_resid_rank + pearson-of-residuals is mathematically equivalent to this for one
    # covariate: both project out the linear effect of rank(z) from rank(x) and rank(y)).
    rx, ry, rz = ag._safe_rank(x), ag._safe_rank(y), ag._safe_rank(z)
    r_xy = ag.pearson(rx, ry)
    r_xz = ag.pearson(rx, rz)
    r_yz = ag.pearson(ry, rz)
    expected = (r_xy - r_xz * r_yz) / np.sqrt((1 - r_xz ** 2) * (1 - r_yz ** 2))

    assert got == pytest.approx(expected, abs=1e-9)
    # sanity: controlling for z should pull the raw x-y correlation down noticeably (y was built to
    # depend on z too), so the partial should differ from the plain Spearman rho.
    plain = ag.spearman(x, y)
    assert abs(got - plain) > 0.01


def test_partial_spearman_zero_when_covariate_fully_explains():
    """x == z and y == z (up to noise-free scaling): controlling for z should drive the partial to ~0."""
    z = np.arange(1, 21, dtype=float)
    x = 3.0 * z
    y = 5.0 * z
    got = ag.partial_spearman(x, y, [z])
    # residual of a perfectly rank-monotone variable against itself is exactly 0 for every entry ->
    # pearson(0-vector, 0-vector) is undefined (nan); this IS the expected, honest degenerate answer.
    assert np.isnan(got)


# =====================================================================================================
# (ii) lineage bootstrap resamples LINEAGES, not checkpoints
# =====================================================================================================
def test_lineage_bootstrap_resamples_lineages_not_checkpoints():
    # one singleton lineage "A" (n=1) and one large lineage "B" (n=9): under an i.i.d. checkpoint-level
    # bootstrap of N=10 slots, a resample is ALWAYS length 10 and a pure-A draw (length 1) is IMPOSSIBLE.
    # Under lineage-level resampling (2 lineage keys, drawn with replacement), a resample where BOTH draws
    # land on "A" happens with probability 0.25 and produces an index array of length 1 (A has one member).
    lineages = np.array(["A"] + ["B"] * 9)
    values = np.array([100.0] + [0.0] * 9)
    groups = ag.lineage_groups(lineages)
    assert set(groups.keys()) == {"A", "B"}

    rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
    lengths_seen = set()
    saw_pure_singleton_A = False
    for _ in range(500):
        idx = ag.lineage_bootstrap_resample_idx(groups, rng)
        lengths_seen.add(len(idx))
        if len(idx) == 1 and values[idx][0] == 100.0:
            saw_pure_singleton_A = True

    # a checkpoint-level (non-lineage) bootstrap of 10 i.i.d. draws is ALWAYS exactly length 10
    assert lengths_seen != {10}, "resample lengths never varied -- looks like checkpoint-level, not lineage-level"
    assert saw_pure_singleton_A, "never saw a resample made purely of the singleton lineage A: not resampling by lineage"


def test_bootstrap_rho_ci_uses_lineage_groups_of_unequal_size():
    """End-to-end: bootstrap_rho_ci must be able to draw a resample dominated by the tiny lineage, which
    should widen the CI far beyond what a checkpoint-level bootstrap of the same data would give."""
    lineages = np.array(["A"] + ["B"] * 9)
    value = np.array([1.0] + list(np.linspace(0, 1, 9)))
    target = np.array([0.0] + list(np.linspace(0, 1, 9)))
    ci = ag.bootstrap_rho_ci(value, target, lineages, n_boot=500, seed=1)
    assert ci["n_boot"] > 0
    # the CI must be wide (lineage A's single extreme point can dominate or vanish a resample)
    assert (ci["ci_hi"] - ci["ci_lo"]) > 0.3


# =====================================================================================================
# (iii) permutation p-value is uniform-ish on a known-null (pure noise) dataset
# =====================================================================================================
def test_permutation_p_value_uniform_ish_on_null_data():
    rng = np.random.default_rng(7)
    n = 23
    value = rng.normal(size=n)
    target = rng.normal(size=n)  # independent of value: the null is TRUE here
    res = ag.checkpoint_perm_null(value, target, sign=1.0, n_perm=2000, seed=42)
    assert res["n_perm"] == 2000
    assert res["p_one_sided"] > 0.2


def test_permutation_p_value_small_for_planted_signal():
    """Sanity counterpart: a strong planted monotone signal should give a tiny p, so the test above is
    not just "the permutation test always returns a big p"."""
    rng = np.random.default_rng(3)
    n = 23
    value = np.arange(n, dtype=float) + rng.normal(scale=0.01, size=n)
    target = np.arange(n, dtype=float) + rng.normal(scale=0.01, size=n)
    res = ag.checkpoint_perm_null(value, target, sign=1.0, n_perm=2000, seed=42)
    assert res["p_one_sided"] < 0.01


# =====================================================================================================
# (iv) S3 orientation flip is applied before the blanket-refuser-vs-parent comparison
# =====================================================================================================
def _toy_wide_and_labels(child_raw: float, parent_raw: float) -> tuple["ag.WideTable", pd.DataFrame]:
    records = [
        {"repo": "parent", "candidate_id": "C10", "variant": "primary", "value": parent_raw,
         "undefined": False, "undefined_reason": None, "n_params": 1e9, "family": "fam",
         "lineage": "lin1", "class": "instruct", "stratum": "chat"},
        {"repo": "child", "candidate_id": "C10", "variant": "primary", "value": child_raw,
         "undefined": False, "undefined_reason": None, "n_params": 1e9, "family": "fam",
         "lineage": "lin1", "class": "blanket_refuser", "stratum": "chat"},
    ]
    wide = ag.WideTable(records)
    labels_df = pd.DataFrame([
        {"repo": "parent", "BALANCED": 0.5, "PRODUCT": 0.5, "family": "fam", "lineage": "lin1", "class": "instruct"},
        {"repo": "child", "BALANCED": 0.1, "PRODUCT": 0.1, "family": "fam", "lineage": "lin1", "class": "blanket_refuser"},
    ])
    return wide, labels_df


def test_s3_orientation_flip_applied_negative_sign():
    # C10 is declared orientation -1 in PREREG.json (higher raw = LESS safe). child's raw value (10) is
    # numerically ABOVE parent's (5): a naive (un-flipped) comparison "child_raw < parent_raw" would say
    # the blanket-refuser check FAILS (10 is not < 5). Once oriented by sign=-1, child_oriented=-10 <
    # parent_oriented=-5, so the check correctly HOLDS -- proving the flip is applied before compare.
    wide, labels_df = _toy_wide_and_labels(child_raw=10.0, parent_raw=5.0)
    res = ag.s3_repaired("C10", -1.0, wide, labels_df, {"child": "parent"})
    check = res["part_i_checks"][0]
    assert check["parent_oriented"] == pytest.approx(-5.0)
    assert check["child_oriented"] == pytest.approx(-10.0)
    assert check["holds"] is True
    assert res["part_i_pass"] is True

    # raw (un-oriented) comparison would have given the OPPOSITE answer -- pin that down explicitly so a
    # future refactor that drops the sign multiplication is caught immediately.
    assert not (child_raw_holds := (10.0 < 5.0))


def test_s3_orientation_flip_applied_positive_sign():
    """Same raw values, orientation +1 (e.g. C1/C2): now the RAW comparison is already the right one, and
    it should FAIL this time (child's raw value is above parent's, and positive orientation keeps it that
    way), showing the flip is genuinely sign-dependent, not a hard-coded direction."""
    wide, labels_df = _toy_wide_and_labels(child_raw=10.0, parent_raw=5.0)
    res = ag.s3_repaired("C10", 1.0, wide, labels_df, {"child": "parent"})
    check = res["part_i_checks"][0]
    assert check["parent_oriented"] == pytest.approx(5.0)
    assert check["child_oriented"] == pytest.approx(10.0)
    assert check["holds"] is False
    assert res["part_i_pass"] is False


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(pytest.main([__file__, "-v"]))
```

OLD: def test_partial_spearman_zero_when_covariate_fully_explains():
    """x == z and y == z (up to noise-free scaling): controlling for z should drive the partial to ~0."""
    z = np.arange(1, 21, dtype=float)
    x = 3.0 * z
    y = 5.0 * z

    # pearson(0-vector, 0-vector) is undefined (nan); this IS the expected, honest degenerate answer.
    assert np.isnan(got)
NEW: def test_partial_spearman_near_zero_when_covariate_fully_explains():
    """x and y are correlated ONLY THROUGH z (independent noise on top): raw rho(x,y) is large and
    positive, but once z is controlled for, the partial should collapse towards 0."""
    rng = np.random.default_rng(99)
    n = 300
    z = rng.normal(size=n)
    x = z + rng.normal(size=n) * 0.05   # x almost equals z
    y = z + rng.normal(size=n) * 0.05   # y almost equals z (independent noise from x's)
    raw = ag.spearman(x, y)
    got = ag.partial_spearman(x, y, [z])
    assert raw > 0.9  # x, y look strongly correlated before controlling for z
    assert abs(got) < 0.25  # controlling for the shared driver collapses the partial towards 0
